## Statement · **draft**
Let $G$ be a group and $g \in G$. The map

$c_g : G \to G, \qquad c_g(x) := g x g^{-1}$

is an automorphism of $G$, the **inner automorphism** determined by $g$. All inner automorphisms

$\operatorname{Inn}(G) := \{\, c_g : g \in G \,\}$
